title: Deterministic audit planning and end-to-end token efficiency

validation.skip_reason: Flask is not installed in the packaging environment

known_limits: The real Qwen Rev4.6 behavioral and token-efficiency smoke test must be run in the deployment environment.
Provider-reported prompt token usage is authoritative when available; otherwise the runtime uses a conservative character-based estimate.
One compact optional audit expansion may be used when deterministic coverage finds a real ambiguous gap.
The optional Flask interface requires its runtime dependency in the final environment.

features.task_intent: deterministic code-domain intent and response profile
features.absence_claims: fresh evidence plus explicit reviewed scope
features.write_finalization: deterministic receipt after tests and reread
features.intent_routing_hardening: natural-language creation nouns no longer trigger project_write
features.exact_recommendation_contract: analysis plus N improvements requires analysis and exactly N recommendation claims
features.tool_error_diagnostics: tool, error_code, retry policy, and bounded detail are exposed
features.write_without_suite: success with partial verification after post-write reread
features.structured_grounding_units: claim annotations are canonical; partial legacy annotations cannot hide unverified facts
features.grounding_claim_filter: one rejected structured claim no longer destroys an otherwise useful grounded analysis
features.confirmed_patch_source: apply_patch reuses the exact last approved dry-run proposal and derives original source from fresh evidence
features.blank_source_range: empty original text is valid only when supported by fresh evidence and the exact dry-run fingerprint
features.code_analysis_sections: plain-language summary, behavior, components, relationships, limitations
features.profiled_claim_rendering: deterministic semantic ordering with paragraph grouping
features.coverage_disclosure: kept in expandable task details and removed from the main answer prefix
features.interface_enumeration: Finalizer explicitly enumerates observable routes, methods, handlers, and return values
features.intent_adherence_units: validated structured claims before human-readable rendering
features.post_grounding_intent_gate: optional grounded claim loss is diagnostic; essential output loss remains blocking
features.evidence_claim_link: fresh evidence IDs linked to stable claim IDs
features.claim_render_link: stable claim IDs linked to deterministic rendered segments
features.rejected_claim_registry: grounding rejections retained with reasons and importance
features.silent_discard_gate: required and essential information cannot disappear before success
features.benchmark_preservation_metrics: preservation gate and silent-discard metrics included per case
features.entendimento_prompt_injection: disabled; legacy metadata remains system-side only
features.compact_project_inventory_prompt: hash, counts, roots, extensions, and completeness only
features.audit_optional_expansion: at most one compact LLM expansion for a real ambiguous gap
features.backend_request_accounting: retries and compatibility fallbacks counted separately
features.tool_catalog_filtering: only tools valid for the current task state are exposed
features.chat_history_budget: whole messages selected by token budget
features.benchmark_token_metrics: logical calls, backend requests, prompt, completion, and total tokens
